title: Redacted
description: Collaborate in writing, tampering, and repairing stories one line at a time.
more: Redacted is an extension upon Raconteur. Players still contribute to a story, however now players are able to interact with the lines other players have written. This game is meant to be played after a familiarity with no context line-by-line stories is established.
howTo: Every player will be given a line in a story
The next player will choose to edit the story by either cutting words off the end, or selecting words in the middle.
Another player will fill in what information was lost
Players will then continue the story, one line at a time
At the end, players can enjoy the crazy stories they wrote
